description: This file defines a Polymer behavior 'IronSelectableBehavior' for creating selectable item lists, including properties, event handling, and item management logic.

classes.name: Polymer.IronSelectableBehavior
classes.description: A Polymer behavior that provides selection capabilities for list-like elements, managing selected items, events, and item filtering.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Returns the index of a given item within the items array.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Sets the selected value, updating the selection state.

methods.name: selectPrevious
methods.description: Selects the previous item in the list, wrapping around if necessary.

methods.name: selectNext
methods.description: Selects the next item in the list, wrapping around if necessary.

methods.name: _addListener
methods.description: Adds an event listener for the specified activation event.

methods.name: _removeListener
methods.description: Removes the event listener for the specified activation event.

methods.name: _activateEventChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the activation event property, updating event listeners accordingly.

methods.name: _updateItems
methods.description: Queries and filters child nodes to update the list of selectable items.

methods.name: _updateSelected
methods.description: Updates the current selection based on the 'selected' property.

methods.name: _selectSelected
methods.description: Selects the item corresponding to the current 'selected' value.

methods.name: _filterItem
methods.description: Filters out nodes with local names specified in '_excludedLocalNames'.

methods.name: _valueToItem
methods.description: Converts a value to its corresponding item in the items array.

methods.name: _valueToIndex
methods.description: Converts a value to its index in the items array, based on 'attrForSelected' if set.

methods.name: _indexToValue
methods.description: Converts an index to its corresponding value, based on 'attrForSelected' if set.

methods.name: _valueForItem
methods.description: Retrieves the attribute or property value used for selection from an item.

methods.name: _applySelection
methods.description: Applies visual and state changes to an item based on its selection status.

methods.name: _selectionChange
methods.description: Updates the 'selectedItem' property when selection changes.

methods.name: _observeItems
methods.description: Sets up a mutation observer to detect changes in the list of items.

methods.name: _activateHandler
methods.description: Handles activation events on items, determining which item was activated.

methods.name: _itemActivate
methods.description: Handles item activation, firing an 'iron-activate' event and updating selection.
